scenario.summary: Attackers target unpatched vulnerabilities in End-of-Life (EoL) IoT devices, such as routers, cameras, and smart controllers, to gain initial network access. Once compromised, these devices are used to pivot into internal networks, redirect users to phishing sites, or are conscripted into large-scale botnets like Mozi and BADBOX 2.0.

meta.rationale: Start with devices identifying as cameras, dvr, or routers. Focus on segments hosting facility-management or building security systems.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in end-of-life IoT devices, evidenced by rare process execution on identified smart hardware, unauthorized external exposure of management ports, and failing states in the IoT control plane.

hunt.name: Exposed IoT Posture and Operational Impact
hunt.description: This hunt identifies end-of-life or unmanaged IoT devices and correlates their presence with behavioural and operational anomalies. We scope the estate using device inventory to identify hardware typical of IoT systems using keyword matching on vendors and hostnames. We then fan out to check independent signals: rare binaries executing on these hosts, internet-exposed management interfaces for matching IoT products, and non-active operational states in Azure IoT Hub. An agent weighs these results to detect compromised devices that may be impacting physical operations or acting as a network beachhead.

config.content: SELECT hostname, hardware_vendor, hardware_model, os_name, first_seen FROM hb_devices WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{iot_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(hostname) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{iot_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(hardware_vendor) || ',') > 0)
config.description: Find hosts whose hardware vendor or hostname matches known IoT profiles to scope the behavioral hunt.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts with IoT-related hardware or naming conventions. Silence indicates no managed IoT devices matching these keywords were found.

primitive_config.label: Identify potential IoT inventory
primitive_config.content: SELECT hostname, hardware_vendor, hardware_model, os_name, first_seen FROM hb_devices WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{iot_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(hostname) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{iot_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(hardware_vendor) || ',') > 0)
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts with IoT-related hardware or naming conventions. Silence indicates no managed IoT devices matching these keywords were found.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS runs, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts, runs
config.description: Identify anomalous binaries or unique process paths on the scoped IoT devices that may indicate malware or exploitation.
config.expected_signal: Binaries seen on only a few IoT hosts. Silence suggests no unusual process execution occurred on the enrolled estate during the window.

primitive_config.label: Rare processes on IoT hosts
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS runs, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts, runs
primitive_config.expected: Binaries seen on only a few IoT hosts. Silence suggests no unusual process execution occurred on the enrolled estate during the window.

config.content: SELECT domain_or_ip, port, product, version, discovered_at FROM hb_exposed_assets WHERE (LOWER(product) LIKE '%camera%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%dvr%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%router%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%gateway%') AND discovered_at >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify internet-exposed ports for IoT products that match the identified internal hardware profiles.
config.expected_signal: External scan results showing management ports (80, 443, 554, 8000) open on your IP space for identified IoT products.

config.content: SELECT name, state, provisioning_state, resource_group FROM azure_iothub WHERE state != 'Active' OR provisioning_state = 'Failed'
config.description: Check the Azure IoT Hub control plane for failed provisioning or inactive states that indicate operational impact.
config.expected_signal: Hubs in a failed or inactive state. This may indicate a control-plane takeover or device-level failure following an exploit.

config.description: Verify if the identified devices are officially end-of-life and plan for replacement.
